findings.current: Every single one was either a First Rate martial artist recognized anywhere under heaven or a Peak master.
findings.defect: The translation omits 초, flattening the finalists from top-tier First Rate martial artists to ordinary First Rate martial artists and weakening the stated hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 초일류 explicitly denotes the highest tier within the First Rate realm, which matters to the competitors’ demonstrated caliber.
findings.replacement: Every single one was either a top-tier First Rate martial artist recognized anywhere under heaven or a Peak master.
findings.source: 하나같이 천하 어디를 가도 인정받는 초일류, 혹은 절정 고수들이다.

findings.current: “Then this old man from the back room will take his leave. Enjoy yourselves.”
findings.defect: The second sentence changes Song Ho’s retrospective statement that he enjoyed meeting everyone into an instruction for the others to enjoy themselves.
findings.rationale: 모두 즐거웠네 expresses Song Ho’s own assessment of the encounter, not a parting wish or command directed at the finalists.
findings.replacement: “Then this old relic will take his leave. It was a pleasure, everyone.”
findings.source: “그럼 뒷방 늙은이는 이만 물러가도록 하지. 모두 즐거웠네.”

findings.defect: The martial maxim is rendered as an unnatural string of noun phrases rather than Baek Woo’s recognition that Taekyung moved second but seized control first.
findings.rationale: 後發先制 describes acting after the opponent yet gaining control before him, matching the immediately explained exchange.

findings.current: “Unfortunately, I have only learned the Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms up to the fifth stage.”
findings.defect: 오 성 means fifty percent mastery here, in direct contrast with the preceding 팔 성, not the fifth stage of the technique.
findings.rationale: The paired quantities 팔 성 and 오 성 indicate eight-tenths and five-tenths of mastery; converting the latter into an ordinal stage changes the technique’s progression mechanism.
findings.replacement: “Unfortunately, I have only mastered fifty percent of the Eighteen Dragon-Subduing Palms.”
findings.source: “허나 안타깝게도 나는 항룡십팔장을 오 성까지밖에 익히지 못했다.”

findings.current:
“M-Might Makes Right. Haven’t you heard of it?”

“Even so, that’s a bit much…”
findings.defect: The draft omits Gung Gibang’s shocked objection to being called casually by name and ordered to use polite speech, then assigns Taekyung’s “Might Makes Right” retort to Gung Gibang.
findings.rationale: The source is a three-turn exchange: Gung Gibang protests, Taekyung invokes 강자지존, and Gung Gibang objects again. Preserving the speakers is necessary for the hierarchy joke and characterization.
findings.replacement:
“G-Gibang? Polite speech?”

“Might Makes Right. Haven’t you heard of it?”

“Even so, that’s a bit much…”

summary: The draft contains one reversed farewell, one misassigned dialogue exchange, and several hierarchy, quantity, and terminology errors.
